challenging the judgment and award dated 06.03.2019 in MVC No.1099/2017, passed by the II Additional District and Sessions Court and Additional MACT.

sentences.text: 2. The claimants filed a claim petition under Section 166 of the MV Act, seeking just and proper compensation for the damages caused to their tractor and trailer due to the rash and negligent driving by the driver of the respondent-Corporation.

3. Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the records.
4.

Although the petitioner did not examine the author of Exhibit-P7/Repair bills-estimate issued by the mechanic, the Tribunal, taking into account Ex.P3, P4, and P5, i.e., Spot and Seizure Mahazar,
Sketch, and IMV report, assessed the damage caused and awarded global compensation of Rs.50,000/-.

5. Learned counsel for the respondent-Corporation vehemently argued that in the absence of documents to establish/substantiate the claim of the claimant, the Tribunal has rightly awarded the compensation amount of Rs.50,000/-.
6. A perusal of Ex.P3 and P4 establishes that the damage was caused to the tractor and trailer belonging to the appellant/claimant by the driver of the bus belonging to the respondent-Corporation.
In my view, it would be appropriate to award Rs.75,000/- to the claimant/appellant as total compensation as opposed to the Rs.50,000/- awarded by the Tribunal.
8. In the result, the appeal is allowed in part.
The judgment of the Claims Tribunal is modified.
The claimant is entitled to a total compensation of Rs.75,000/- as opposed to the Rs.50,000/- awarded by the Tribunal.
